summary: Complete a mentored product-design project and develop design skills through hands-on training.
requirements: Required: second-year bachelor student in design/HCI or related field, graduating fall 2028 or spring/summer 2029; at least two college design courses, transcript, screen-design-tool experience and a portfolio of 1–2 independently driven projects.
conditions: Full-time, ten weeks in Pittsburgh, June–August. Application deadline 2026-12-09. This is a specifically targeted undergraduate programme.
